x: Then followed a string of runners before we again saw a Belgrave vest filled by Eddie Short who had John Moore and Jumbo Masters close on his heels, all of them in the 130's.

At the end of the first lap Clive Shippen was leading with Moore and Short well in attendance. A quick check showed that we were well in the lead and should have no difficulty in holding our position.
